For teachers and tutors

About Beginner Build Word

A blending and segmenting game. The learner hears a short word and puts its sound tiles in order, like m, a, n for "man". Each tile plays its sound, recorded by a real voice. It is the step from hearing sounds to spelling words.

How to play

  1. Listen to the word.
  2. Tap or drag the sound tiles into order.
  3. Check your word.

Play it as a class

Choose Beginner Build Word in the Teacher Game. Students build the word on their phones and the answers show on the projector.
